verdict.rationale: Sierra provides explicit tone/brand-voice controls via Ghostwriter prompts (tone, style, guardrails) and Voice Personas tuned across 55-60+ languages/locales, plus cross-channel deployment (chat, phone, email, SMS) supporting consistency. However, evidence is entirely first-party marketing with no independent/hands-on verification that tone actually stays consistent across topics and languages in practice. Missing for 10: independent case studies or benchmarks confirming cross-language/topic consistency, and any customer testimonial specifically validating brand-voice consistency.
